entries.order: Mo > Fe > Co > Ni（与 N 结合从强到弱）
entries.source: OSTI 报告（NRR 催化剂设计综述，含 Jacobsen 2001 火山图转述）
entries.quote: From the volcano curve, the relative affinity for these metals from strongest to weakest interactions with N2 are as follows Mo > Fe > Co > Ni (Figure 3). Activities for ternary nitrides were 2.6 to 4 times higher than γ-Mo2N and activities increased up to 30 times when 5 wt% cesium nitrate was incorporated

entries.order: 强吸附侧 Re, Mo, Fe；弱吸附侧 Co, Ni（Pd 更弱）；峰附近 Fe, Ru；CoMo 双金属插值最优
entries.source: Liu et al. Nat. Commun. 2018 + PMC12112505 综述
entries.quote_1: Stronger adsorption of N atom implies lower N2 dissociation barrier but higher NHx desorption energies, such as on Re, Mo, Fe metal surfaces; while weaker adsorption of N atom indicates higher N2 dissociation barrier and lower NHx desorption energies, such as on Pd, Co, Ni metal surfaces.
entries.quote_2: Near the volcano peak, metals like Fe, and Ru exhibit intermediate nitrogen binding, with CoMo emerging as the most effective catalyst

entries.order: Co3Mo3N 活性最高（Cs 促进前后均然）；Fe3Mo3N、Ni2Mo3N 亦高活
entries.source: Hargreaves 综述（Appl. Petrochem. Res. 2014, 4, 3-10, OA PDF）转述 Jacobsen 2001
entries.quote: The volcano curve can also be used to rationalise the relatively high ammonia synthesis activity of the Ni2Mo3N phase. Fe3Mo3N, which is iso-structural with Co3Mo3N, is also a high activity ternary nitride for the reaction

standard_statement.text: 理想催化剂应以中等强度结合反应中间体——太强阻碍产物脱附，太弱妨碍中间体吸附；由此产生活性对吸附能的火山型关系
standard_statement.source: arXiv:2510.10555 引言（2025 OA 论文，转述教科书共识）
standard_statement.quote: It postulates that an ideal catalyst should bind reaction intermediates with moderate strength—neither too strongly, which hinders product desorption, nor too weakly, which impedes intermediate adsorption. This intrinsic trade-off results in the well-known volcano-type activity relationship

ammonia_specific_statement.text: 合成氨语境：最优催化剂的 N 吸附足够强以活化 N2，又足够弱以允许后续加氢与 NHx 脱附
ammonia_specific_statement.quote: This trend aligns with Sabatier's principle: optimal catalysts exhibit intermediate nitrogen adsorption, strong enough to activate N2, but weak enough to permit subsequent hydrogenation and desorption.

standard_form_catalysis.form: E_a = E_0 + α·ΔH（活化能与反应焓线性相关；对 N2 解离步，ΔH 用 N 吸附能描述）
standard_form_catalysis.note: 该线性形式在 Nørskov 组文献中通称 BEP；本次核验到其理论出处为 Evans–Polanyi LFER
standard_form_catalysis.source: 综合 PMC12112505 §5.1 与 OGST 综述

evans_polanyi_original_form.parameter_meaning: β1 截距（内在势垒项），β2 斜率（过渡态位置/反应焓向活化能的传递系数，0=早垒平坦，1=晚垒完全传递）；β1、β2 依赖于势能面直线近似的斜率与反应物-产物初始距离
evans_polanyi_original_form.source: Oil & Gas Science and Technology – Rev. IFP Energies nouvelles 71(3) (2016) 45（动力学方法综述，OA）
evans_polanyi_original_form.quote: The origin of such linear free-energy relationships was first derived by Evans and Polanyi (1935, 1936, 1938), who approximated the PES by straight lines. This approximation leads to ... ΔG‡ = β1 + β2·ΔG_R (20) where β1 and β2 depend on the slopes of the lines and the initial distance between reactants and products. ... Evans and Polanyi (1938) also showed that the activation energies depend linearly on the reaction enthalpies.

bronsted_equation.form: k = α1·(Ka)^α2，线性化 ln(k) = α1 + α2·ln(Ka)
bronsted_equation.source: 同上 OGST 综述，引 Brønsted and Pedersen 1924; Brønsted 1928
bronsted_equation.quote: For homogeneous acid-catalyzed reactions, Brønsted (Brønsted and Pedersen, 1924; Brønsted, 1928) observed that strongly exothermic reactions have a low activation energy and derived ... k = α1·(Ka)^α2

bronsted_1928_doi.citation: J. N. Brønsted, 'Acid and Basic Catalysis.' Chemical Reviews 1928, 5(3), 231（DOI: 10.1021/cr60019a001，Crossref 核验题名/期刊/年份；页码 231 起为待核验参考）
